metadata.title: Sets of reach $R$ are $\operatorname{CAT}\left( 1/R^2\right)$
metadata.abstract: Positive reach underpins many results in computational geometry and topology. It is used for triangulation criteria, topological inference, and manifold learning. The geometric properties of these sets have therefore been studied intensely. In this paper we focus on the intrinsic metric properties of sets of positive reach. In particular we give an elementary proof of the fact that (closed) sets of reach at least $R$ are $\operatorname{CAT}(1/R^2)$. This fact was established earlier by Alexander and Bishop, using quite significant machinery. The fact that a space is $\operatorname{CAT}(1/R^2)$ offers many advantages, such as the uniqueness and continuity of sufficiently short geodesics, the existence of Fr{é}chet means and by extension the Rips based homotopy reconstruction of Hausmann is available.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 正reach集合CAT曲率上界的初等证明
analysis.workSummary: 对闭且reach至少R的集合，作者给其内蕴长度度量满足CAT(1/R²)的初等证明。该曲率上界原已由Alexander–Bishop用更强工具建立，本文重点是证明方法简化，并联系短测地唯一连续性、Fréchet均值及Rips型同伦重构。
analysis.breakthrough: 为计算几何和拓扑推断提供已有曲率定理的直接证明。
analysis.limitations: CAT结论作用于内蕴度量，并保留闭与正reach条件；均值唯一性及重构还涉及尺度/局部范围，不能据摘要断言任意尺度全局唯一。该曲率事实并非首次发现。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第31页minimax来自统计学参考文献的极小极大最优性，第33页Claude是数学家Jean-Claude Hausmann的姓名，均非模型使用。第31页致谢为学者和评审建议；全文候选及拆行/点写补检未发现作者自身AI使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 非光滑比较几何基础工具，适用面广。
